Introduction

AHOF (All-Time Hall of Famer) is a nine-member South Korean boy group under F&F Entertainment. The group was formed through the survival show Universe League, which aired from November 22, 2024, to its finale on January 24, 2025. The group debuted on July 1, 2025.

The final lineup of AHOF consists of seven members from Team Rhythm, which won the "Prism Cup" in the competition. These members are JL, Steven, Shuaibo, Juwon, Jeongwoo, Chih En, and Daisuke. Two additional members, Woongki from Team Beat and Han from Team Groove, completed the group. Their name signifies excellence and reflects the Hangul translation for "nine."

Several members had notable pre-debut activities. Steven previously competed on Produce X 101 and debuted with the boy group LUMINOUS. Cha Woong Ki gained recognition as a former member of TO1 and as a contestant on World Klass and Boys Planet. JL is currently active as a member of the Filipino boy group PLUUS. Zhang Shuai Bo also participated in Youth With You 3 and Boys Planet.
